notes.title: 🚨 We just hit 6,000 downloads!
notes.content:
[h3]🚨 We just hit [b]6,000 downloads[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]I made [i]Is This A Platformer?[/i] solo, and now thousands of people have it in their Steam library — this feels surreal.
[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who's checking it out. If you’ve played it and enjoyed it, a short review helps a lot. ❤️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969179/40f21154a91ff3a1632a44c905fd162e4803e827.jpg"][/img][/p]
